## ClaudeMC v1.20.7 [MC 1.21.11]

### Censys + FOFA Server Discovery

Two new data sources added to **ServerFinder** and the **Companion web app**, giving you a much wider server discovery net beyond mcscans.fi and Shodan.

---

#### ServerFinder — new modes

The Mode dropdown now has six options:

| Mode | Source |
|---|---|
| Both / Vulnerable / P2W / AI Search | mcscans.fi (unchanged) |
| **FOFA** *(new)* | fofa.info — internet-wide scan, strong Asian coverage |
| **Censys** *(new)* | app.censys.io — Censys v3 global asset search |

**FOFA mode**
- Query sent: `port="25565" && protocol="minecraft"` (base64-encoded per FOFA API spec)
- Returns: ip, port, protocol, country, banner, host
- Results cross-referenced against VulnDb — vulnerable servers highlighted in red
- Requires: `fofaApiKey` in `config/claudemc/ai.json` (free tier: 100 queries/day, 100 results each)

**Censys mode**
- POST to `https://api.platform.censys.io/v3/global/asset/search` with query `services.port=25565`
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <PAT>`
- Returns: ip, services.port, services.service_name, services.banner
- Results cross-referenced against VulnDb
- Requires: Censys Personal Access Token + **Starter plan or higher** (free accounts = lookup only, not search)

---

#### Companion web app — new routes

| Route | Method | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/censys` | POST | Censys asset search; body: `{query, perPage}` |
| `/api/fofa` | POST | FOFA search; body: `{query, size}` |
| `/api/settings` GET/POST | — | Now exposes and accepts `censysApiKey` and `fofaApiKey` |

Both routes return `{results: [...], total: N}` matching the existing Shodan route shape, with a `source` field (`"censys"` or `"fofa"`) on every result row.

---

#### AIConfig — two new fields

`config/claudemc/ai.json` now has two additional optional fields:

```json
{
  "censysApiKey": "your-censys-personal-access-token",
  "fofaApiKey":   "your-fofa-api-key"
}
```

Set them via the Companion Settings tab (no file editing needed) or paste directly into the JSON.

---

### README — API Keys section

New dedicated section **"API Keys — Where to Get Them"** documents all six keys:

| Key | Sign-up URL | Free tier |
|---|---|---|
| Anthropic | console.anthropic.com → API Keys | $5 credits on signup |
| OpenAI | platform.openai.com → API keys | Requires billing (min ~$5) |
| Gemini | aistudio.google.com → Get API key | Free, 15 req/min, no card |
| Shodan | shodan.io → Account | 100 results/query |
| Censys | app.censys.io/account/api → PAT | Lookup only; Starter+ for search |
| FOFA | fofa.info/user/info → API Key | 100 queries/day, 100 results |

Each entry includes: exact URL, step-by-step account creation, what the key starts with, free tier limits, and how to enter it in ClaudeMC.
